name: Barrow mound
description: A mound in the wild grasses of the High Moors holding the remnants of a wizards' sanctum that is still being plundered.

timeline.summary: Pursuing the wizards leads the adventurers to a barrow mound where a wizards' sanctum is being plundered.
timeline.quote: At the barrow, they discover the remnants of a wizards' sanctum still being plundered.

relations.note: The barrow stands in the wild grasses of the High Moors.
